## What it is

A short foot, one clip, and a diamond gauge, joined by a tab. The lug is the 0° tower's lug.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, like a tower. The gauge sits on a 2 mm flat so the first layer is not a single line. That flat is the bed scar, not part of the mating diamond.
- Slide the gauge into the socket after snapping the tab. The 0.2 mm allowance is a design choice. If it binds, change it before printing the towers.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the cap and the coil are stiff. It only checks the diamond and one clip.
